title: Everyone Gets A Software Company — Benjamin Guo, Zo Computer
talk_summary: This is a product pitch for Zo Computer, a personal cloud server with a built-in AI agent, aimed at non-technical consumers who want to replace SaaS subscriptions with a self-hosted workspace.

takeaways.technique: Per-user persistent cloud VM with root access and built-in hosting
takeaways.what_they_do: Each user gets a dedicated Linux VM in the cloud with root access, SSH, API/MCP control, and the ability to host arbitrary HTTP/TCP services and files directly, so the agent and the hosted services share one machine.
takeaways.evidence_quote: You have like root access to your own server to this very nicely set up Linux VM

takeaways.what_they_do: They describe a beta where anyone can publish an agent and end usage improves the published agent itself, i.e. usage feedback loops back into the agent definition.
takeaways.evidence_quote: have the end usage of their agent improve, like self-improve their own kind of published agent
